column2: Spells can be held in the ITEMS space in inventory and used like throwable items.
Your currently held wand loses some of its capacity, but gains more mana.
Your being spews an endless stream of fiery projectiles.
Your being spews an endless stream of thunderous bolts.
Your being spews an endless stream of eldritch tendrils.
A vicious curse gnaws away at you.
You feel as though your body can go on without you.
Your being is drawing in nearby projectiles.
You have become something exceptionally rare.
Wands are charmed by your presence and give their blessing to tinker with them everywhere.
